title: ReportEnhancedLocalWaypointCapabilities
description:
This message is used to report additional waypoint capabilities supported by this service. Specifically,
                    this message will report a list of all planners or planning algorithms a client may select from, if multiple
                    planner types are supported.

MessageID.comment: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

PlannerID.comment: A numeric ID associated with this particular planner or planner algorithm

PlannerName.comment: Human readable name associated with the planner or planning algorithm.

PlannerDescription.comment: Human readable description associated with the planner or planning algorithm.
